question: Dandi, the destination of the Dandi Salt March under the leadership of Mahatma Gandhi, is situated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The British in 1882 prohibited Indians from collecting or selling salt,** a staple in their diet, and called it as **Salt Law.**
 
• Defying the Salt Act, Gandhi simply made Indians break the British law nonviolently.
 
• **The Salt Satyagraha (Dandi March), which took place from March to April 1930 in India.**
 
• It was an act of civil disobedience led by M.K Gandhi to protest British rule in India.
 
• During the march, thousands of Indians followed Gandhi from his religious retreat near **Ahmedabad (Gujarat).**
 
• The march resulted in the arrest of nearly 60,000 people, including Gandhi himself.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• About Mahatma Gandhi:

 
 
• Mahatma Gandhi (Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi) was born on October 2, 1869.
 
• He died January 30, 1948, in Delhi, and the day is celebrated as Shaheed Diwas or Martyrs' Day.
 
 
 
• His autobiography is titled My Experiments with Truth.
 
• Other Important movements led by Mahatma Gandhi:
 
 
• ​Champaran Movement (1917)
 
• Kheda Movement (1918)
 
• Khilafat Movement (1919)
 
• Non Cooperation Movement (1920-22)
 
• Quit India Movement (1942)
